body.text: Sales coordinators on WhatsApp often quote graft ranges in minutes without a doctor ever seeing your scalp. [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about) operates as an independent, client-paid, flat-fee travel and medical travel advisory run by its two founders in Türkiye—paid by our clients and independent of provider commissions. Use this vetting framework before paying any deposit.
What 10 questions expose whether a clinic is transparent?

Transparent clinics give clear, written answers about the named surgeon's exact hands-on role, daily patient cap, legal health-tourism license, graft-count estimation method and complication protocol. Vague replies, pressure discounts or refusal to name the doctor performing your incisions are immediate red flags highlighted by international surgical societies.

Both the [ISHRS Fight the FIGHT campaign](https://fightthefight.ishrs.org/) and the [American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) question guide](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/cosmetic-procedures/hair-transplantation-and-restoration/questions) stress confirming who physically executes invasive steps—not just whose name sits on the clinic door.

items: 1. Named surgeon: What is the full name and medical license number of the physician leading my surgery?
2. Hands-on steps: Which steps (donor scoring, extraction, channel incisions, implantation) does the doctor perform personally versus technicians?
3. Daily volume: How many patients does that surgeon treat per day?

4. Authorization: What is the clinic's [Turkish Ministry of Health Health Tourism Authorization](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) number?
5. Facility type: Is surgery performed inside a licensed hospital or medical centre with emergency equipment on site?
6. Donor conservation: How do you prevent over-harvesting if I experience future hair loss?
7. Comparable portfolio: Can I review unedited 12-month results matching my hair texture and thinning pattern?
8. Graft counting: Will I receive a written post-op graft breakdown of single and multi-hair units?
9. Emergency protocol: What happens clinically and financially if an infection or complication occurs during my stay?
10. Discharge records: Will I receive an English operative summary listing medications and washing instructions before flying home?

body.text: How do you check if blood tests, medications and follow-ups are included?

Request a single line-item quote in writing before booking flights, listing pre-op blood screening (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, clotting panel), local anaesthesia, post-op antibiotics, wash kit, airport transfers and 12-month remote check-ins. Verbal "all-inclusive" promises frequently hide paid add-ons such as PRP injections, extra shampoo packs or sedation upgrades.

body.text: Note that [ISHRS warning-sign guidance](https://ishrs.org/three-warning-signs-hair-transplants/) cautions against clinics relying on promotional add-ons rather than transparent medical disclosures.
Why should your pre-op consultation happen face-to-face with the surgeon?

An in-person consultation lets the licensed physician measure donor density under magnification, check scalp elasticity, assess miniaturization and draw an age-appropriate hairline in real daylight. Remote photo quotes cannot measure follicular unit thickness or detect underlying scalp conditions that could alter—or rule out—surgery.

Never feel locked into proceeding just because you flew to Istanbul. A reputable doctor explains realistic coverage limits, checks curved-follicle considerations if relevant (see our [Afro-textured hair transplant verification guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/afro-hair-transplant-turkey)), and advises against surgery if donor supply is insufficient. [ISHRS](https://ishrs.org/questions-ask-your-hair-doctor/) reminds patients there is no "scarless" hair restoration.

Because Itinerary of Türkiye charges a transparent flat fee paid strictly by you, we have zero financial stake in which clinic you select—or even whether you decide to proceed at all. We verify each facility's public authorization status, align appointments with your hotel and airport transfers, and organize neutral comparison notes without pushing any partner. faq.q: Is it normal to pay a deposit before seeing the surgeon in person?
faq.a: Many clinics request a modest deposit to hold a surgery date, but always confirm in writing whether it is refundable if the in-person exam shows you are not a suitable candidate.

faq.q: How can I check if a clinic is registered on HealthTürkiye?
faq.a: Under Türkiye's [International Health Tourism Regulation](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-108974/regulation-on-international-health-tourism-and-tourist-health.html), authorized providers must hold Ministry of Health certification and integrate with the national [HealthTürkiye portal](https://www.turkiyetoday.com/lifestyle/turkiye-launches-new-health-tourism-portal-to-standardize-services-149806).

faq.q: Should I book my surgery for the same morning I land?
faq.a: No. Arriving at least one day early gives you time for rest, unhurried face-to-face consultation and blood testing without jet lag.

faq.q: Are PRP injections required during a hair transplant?
faq.a: PRP is an optional adjunct rather than a universal requirement. Ask your surgeon whether it offers measurable benefit in your case before paying extra.

faq.q: What if a clinic promises "unlimited grafts" in one day?
faq.a: Treat unlimited-graft marketing with caution. Safe extraction limits depend strictly on your donor density and scalp health, not package tiers.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye recommend one preferred clinic?
faq.a: No. We are independent of provider commissions and never promote a single partner clinic; you choose your licensed medical team after comparing verified options.
